operations.description: Lists the domains that have been registered by the client. The order of domains in the response is unspecified and non-deterministic. Newly created domains will not necessarily be added to the end of this list.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] gmailpostmastertools domains list [PATH] v 1beta 1 domains [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth page pretty print protocol quota size token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] domain domains list response

operations.description: Get traffic statistics for a domain on a specific date. Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if user does not have permission to access TrafficStats for the domain.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] gmailpostmastertools domains traffic stats [PATH] v 1beta 1 [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] delivery error feedback ip loop reputation stats traffic

operations.description: List traffic statistics for all available days. Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if user does not have permission to access TrafficStats for the domain.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] gmailpostmastertools domains traffic stats list [PATH] v 1beta 1 traffic stats [PARAMS] access alt callback date day end fields key month oauth page parent pretty print protocol quota size start token type upload user xgafv year [SCHEMA] delivery error feedback ip list loop reputation response stats traffic
